G: upper teeth touching the lower lip for F/V.

X: relaxed closed idle mouth with a subtle happy smile.

Keep all nine poses distinct, correctly registered, and within one native pixel-art style. Preserve skin, jaw, chin, hair, and all pixels outside the mouth shape. Do not add a neck band, lower-face shift, extra teeth, gutters, borders, labels, letters, watermark, or background.
